status: FROZEN 2026-10-12 (Josue approved on the decision card: freeze and run, 15:26 UTC). M1 is the only decision-bearing interval; NB is descriptive and cannot replace M1. Changing anything here after the freeze needs a protocol-change RDR.
name: EV-1b: synthetic coverage check of the candidate M1 interval (post-EV-1 protocol change; 11 LOG-2026-10-12-M1-CANDIDATE)

inference.method: src/evaluation/taxonomy.py m1_ci: (1/J + n_test/n_train) * S^2 + s^2(Delta_p)/n_E, t with n_E - 1 df
inference.description: an augmented conservative variance estimator that adds explicit patient-sampling variance to the Nadeau-Bengio corrected repeated-CV variance to protect against shared training-set variance inadequately represented by the fold-mean variance

pos_boundary_ne33.target: pos_hetero gain with n_E = 33 (stress 3): the 2 E patients with the fewest evaluable IED epochs become training-only N

criteria.indeterminate: a 1,000-dataset scenario that is INDETERMINATE is extended once to 2,000 (pre-registered); nothing else changes
criteria.fail: any scenario FAIL: stop; no further ad-hoc variance inflation; new RDR considering a fundamentally different method (e.g. nested-CV inference)

calibration.method: theta only (training sets + fresh test patients; no intervals, no coverage), src/design/ev1_coverage.py theta --gamma
calibration.note: theta used for coverage is recomputed with the theta seed 2026101602 at m = 200, as for every scenario
